content.text:
The chat input text is now 8px from the box's top, left and right; before, it was 8px at the top but 18px on each side.

**Cause:** the text box has 10px of padding on each side and 8px top and bottom. On top of that it keeps a 10px gutter on the left, where line numbers would go, and wraps lines 10px short of its right edge. The earlier fix only made up for the 2px padding difference, which left 18px on each side.

**Fix** (`src/chat_input.rs`):
- The text box now extends 12px past each side of the dark box, which covers the gutter and the right margin too.
- The dark box now clips whatever sticks out, so the text box can't overlap the buttons.
- The completion menu draws outside the box, so the clip doesn't cut it off, and its tests still pass.

**Test:** I added `the_text_is_inset_evenly_in_its_box`. It fills the input with enough text to wrap, then checks where lines start and wrap against the box edges. It measured 18 / 8 / 18 px (left / top / right) with the old code and 8 / 8 / 8 px now. It checks layout positions, not drawn pixels, because the test renderer doesn't draw text.

**Full suite:** 379 passed and 4 failed. They're the same 4 as last time, and I'd already confirmed they fail without my changes. Three are the code-to-spec handoff tests that broke when `.suspense/system-prompts/code-to-spec.md` changed; the fourth is `defaults_are_this_repositorys_templates`, which was failing from the start of the session.
